newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack invites tenders for track renewal.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack invites tenders for track renewal.

text.p: Britain's rail network operator Railtrack Group Plc said on Monday that it was inviting tenders for up to one billion stg worth of work on track renewals and associated haulage.
It invited companies to put forward tenders by August 26. Railtrack expected contracts would be let in October 1997 with work due to start in May 1998, running to 2002.
The contracts would form part of Railtrack's plan to spend 16 billion stg on the railway infrastructure over the next 10 years.
